## Pathway Enrichment

```{r gsea-methods, results='asis'}
cat("\n\nGene-set enrichment on the DESeq2 ranked gene list for each contrast, ",
    "run independently against every requested MSigDB collection.\n\n", sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Key functions used for pathway enrichment:",
  "msigdbr::msigdbr(species = \"Homo sapiens\", collection = \"H\")",
  "fgsea::fgsea(pathways, stats = ranked_genes, eps = 0)",
  "fgsea::collapsePathways(fgsea_res, pathways, stats)  # optional redundancy filter",
  "clusterProfiler::GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = ...)    # optional parallel run"
)
```

```{r gsea-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_gsea_contrast <- function(comp, by_coll, by_coll_cp = NULL, coll_heading = "#####") {
  cat(" {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
  for (coll in names(by_coll)) {
    cat("\n\n", coll_heading, " Collection: ", coll, "\n\n", sep = "")
    gsea_df <- by_coll[[coll]]
    if (is.null(gsea_df) || nrow(gsea_df) == 0) {
      cat("\n\nNo pathways returned.\n\n")
      next
    }
    p <- tryCatch(deseq2reports::plot_gsea_barplot(gsea_df, top_n = 10, title = comp),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      sz <- attr(p, "plot_size")
      if (is.null(sz)) sz <- list(width = 6.5, height = 5)
      deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
        p, filename = paste(comp, coll, "gsea_barplot", sep = "_"),
        width = sz$width, height = sz$height, dpi = 150
      )
    }

    cat("\n\nTop 10 up- and top 10 down-regulated pathways by normalized enrichment score (NES), ",
        "shown regardless of significance; ",
        "significance stars: `*` padj < 0.05, `**` < 0.01, `***` < 0.001. ",
        "`leadingEdge` lists the driving genes for each pathway. Sort by any column or search ",
        "by pathway using the box below.\n\n", sep = "")
    top_bottom_gsea <- deseq2reports::gsea_top_bottom_table(gsea_df, top_n = 10)
    gsea_btn <- deseq2reports::download_table_button(gsea_df, filename = paste(comp, coll, "gsea_results", sep = "_"))
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(top_bottom_gsea), gsea_btn)

    if (!is.null(by_coll_cp) && !is.null(by_coll_cp[[coll]])) {
      cat("\n\nA parallel `clusterProfiler::GSEA()` run against the same ranked gene list ",
          "and gene sets is also available (unfiltered `gseaResult` object and CSV export, ",
          "written alongside the `fgsea`-based results above).\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (is.null(specs)) {
  comps <- names(params$gsea_out$by_comparison)
  specs <- data.frame(
    label = comps,
    class = "single",
    type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
    stratum_var = NA_character_,
    stratum_level = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
# Keep only contrasts that have GSEA results
specs <- specs[specs$label %in% names(params$gsea_out$by_comparison), , drop = FALSE]
two_factor <- any(specs$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction"))
```

```{r gsea-single, results='asis', eval=!two_factor}
gsea_pairwise <- specs$label[specs$type == "pairwise"]
gsea_one_vs_all <- specs$label[specs$type == "one_vs_all"]

cat("\n\n### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(gsea_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in gsea_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, sep = "")
    emit_gsea_contrast(comp, params$gsea_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                       params$gsea_out$by_comparison_cp[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(gsea_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in gsea_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, sep = "")
    emit_gsea_contrast(comp, params$gsea_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                       params$gsea_out$by_comparison_cp[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r gsea-two-factor, results='asis', eval=two_factor}
var <- params$var
for (cls in c("within_A", "within_B", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs[specs$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    for (comp in sub$label) {
      cat("\n\n#### ", comp, sep = "")
      emit_gsea_contrast(comp, params$gsea_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                         params$gsea_out$by_comparison_cp[[comp]])
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    # Flatten pairwise then one-vs-all under the stratum tabset (avoids
    # heading depth > 6 for collection tabs).
    ordered <- c(st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n##### ", comp, sep = "")
      emit_gsea_contrast(comp, params$gsea_out$by_comparison[[comp]],
                         params$gsea_out$by_comparison_cp[[comp]],
                         coll_heading = "######")
    }
  }
}
```
